reasons.en: negative-gamma tape — dealer hedging amplifies the move (fuel for a breakout)
reasons.zh: 负 Gamma 行情 — 做市商对冲放大波动（利于突破）

reasons.en: short-gamma expansion — realized vol elevated, no suppressive band
reasons.zh: 空头 Gamma 扩张 — 已实现波动升高，无抑制带

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -13.4 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -13.4 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

fusion.construction: Per member: within-night cross-sectional percentile rank (average ties) of the value oriented by its REGISTERED sign. Per family: the mean of its present members' percentiles. Fusion: the equal-weight mean of the present family scores, x100. No interactions, no fitting beyond the per-night normalization, no weight read off any outcome. A member below 50% non-null coverage on tonight's pool DROPS (presence floor); a member with fewer than 2 distinct non-null oriented values tonight is VOTE-INERT (variance floor) and is disclosed rather than hidden; a family with no surviving member is ABSENT with its reason; a row missing a family is scored on the mean of ITS present families, and a row with no family at all scores null — never zero.

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

prophet.score_kind: unfitted equal-weight evidence-family vote; a breadth-of-evidence ordering, not a calibrated return forecast and not a promoted alpha model

fusion.construction: Per member: within-night cross-sectional percentile rank (average ties) of the value oriented by its REGISTERED sign. Per family: the mean of its present members' percentiles. Fusion: the equal-weight mean of the present family scores, x100. No interactions, no fitting beyond the per-night normalization, no weight read off any outcome. A member below 50% non-null coverage on tonight's pool DROPS (presence floor); a member with fewer than 2 distinct non-null oriented values tonight is VOTE-INERT (variance floor) and is disclosed rather than hidden; a family with no surviving member is ABSENT with its reason; a row missing a family is scored on the mean of ITS present families, and a row with no family at all scores null — never zero.

prophet_shadow.authority: none — display and forward-grading only; originates no plan, controls no Featured slot, sets no priority and moves no user-visible order

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +19.1 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +19.1 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。
